title: Multiple-testing trap across 20 A/B guardrail metrics
what: 1/20 metrics hitting raw p = 0.038 is expected by chance; after BH/Bonferroni correction adj_p = 0.76 (zero significant wins)

reader_questions.question: How many of the 20 metrics remain significant after multiple-testing adjustment?
reader_questions.expected: Zero (search_click_depth has raw p = 0.038 but BH-adjusted p = 0.76).

reader_questions.question: What uncertainty or error information is shown?
reader_questions.expected: Per-metric SE / 95% CIs and both raw and adjusted p-values across 20 tests.

reader_questions.question: Why shouldn't search_click_depth be announced as a launch win?
reader_questions.expected: Testing 20 null metrics at α = 0.05 produces ~1 false positive by chance alone.
